FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the comforts of worldly life and whether you were grateful to Allāh for His blessings.","number":1,"order":54}]

AyahText: By time,{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"An oath in which Allāh swears by time throughout the ages.","number":1,"order":8}]

AyahText: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Rather than spending in the way of Allāh.","number":1,"order":49}]

AyahText: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., Hellfire, which crushes and destroys all that enters it.","number":1,"order":46}]

AyahText: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Covering them and penetrating them.","number":1,"order":36}]

AyahText: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
In extended columns.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Interpreted to be either columns of fire or columns of iron to which are chained the inmates of Hell.","number":1,"order":20}]

AyahText: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the army under the command of Abrahah al-Ashram which was accompanied by a huge elephant and came with the intention of destroying the Kaʿbah at Makkah.","number":1,"order":95}]

AyahText: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Causing them to perish.","number":1,"order":44}]

AyahText: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., husks which have been chewed by cattle. This event took place in the year of the Prophet\u0027s birth.","number":1,"order":34}]

AyahText: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh{[1]} -
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the honor and reputation Allāh had given them as guardians of the Holy Kaʿbah, which allowed them to travel without fear of being harmed.","number":1,"order":42}]

AyahText: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer{[1]} -
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the trading caravans that traveled south in winter and north in summer.","number":1,"order":63}]

AyahText: Let them worship the Lord of this House,{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the Kaʿbah.","number":1,"order":40}]

AyahText: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer{[1]} -
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., the hypocrites who are unconcerned if they miss prayers when no one sees them.","number":1,"order":38}]

AyahText: Those who make show [of their deeds]
And withhold [simple] assistance.
Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"From all good in this world and the Hereafter.","number":1,"order":38}]

AyahText: Say, "O disbelievers,
I do not worship what you worship.
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"The conquest of Makkah.","number":1,"order":52}]

AyahText: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Refer to footnote of 2:37","number":1,"order":113}]

AyahText: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Abū Lahab (the Prophet\u0027s uncle) , who was an enemy of Islām.","number":1,"order":55}]

AyahText: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"She used to put thorns in the Prophet\u0027s path and slander him (ﷺ) . The word \"firewood\" was used by the Arabs to allude to slander and backbiting.","number":1,"order":49}]

AyahText: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.","number":1,"order":32}]

AyahText: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.","number":1,"order":26}]

AyahText: He neither begets nor is born,
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
And from the evil of the blowers in knots{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., those who practice magic.","number":1,"order":41}]

AyahText: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
The Sovereign of mankind,
The God of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer{[1]} -
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.","number":1,"order":41}]

AyahText: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
From among the jinn and mankind".{[1]}
FootNotes: [{"footnote":"Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.","number":1,"order":33}]
